original.statement: Support for Kubernetes client impersonate flags has been added to istioctl.

decision.reason: [ev-eb9884e0aaab] says only that istioctl gained support for "the impersonate flags used in kube client". It never names the flags, so the specific flags in the proposal, `--as` and `--as-group`, come from outside the evidence. A cli-flag leaf checks the container arguments of the product's workloads, and an istioctl client invocation is not one of those. Also, nothing happens to an environment whose operator does nothing after an added optional CLI capability, so there is no environment state to express as a correct exposure condition.
